name: com.eyeofcloud.ab.android.datafile_handler.DatafileRescheduler
description: Eyeofcloud's experimentation SDK receives boot and app-update broadcasts here, then schedules background refreshes for its experiment datafiles. These files can contain remote settings used by feature experiments and rollouts.
disableEffect: An app that depends on Eyeofcloud-managed experiments may keep stale settings after startup or an update.
